subject: Cross-cloud procurement orchestration & MAP for Meridian Labs (AWS private offer + GCP eval)
messages:
From: Emma Sorensen <emma@meridianlabs.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.com
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@meridianlabs.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Apr 2029 09:13:00 -0700
Subject: Request: MAP + timeline for AWS private offer (Meridian evaluation)

Hi Markus —

Thanks for the demo last week. Meridian is ready to run a short evaluation across GCP (pilot) while we plan to purchase via an AWS Private Offer (preferred for our procurement and discount stacking). Procurement asked for a mutual action plan (MAP) that lines up evaluation milestones, security intake, and the exact steps for a private offer purchase and billing path.

High-level asks from our side:
- MAP with milestone owners & dates (evaluation gating criteria, security evidence, PO dates)
- Confirmation you can deliver an AWS Private Offer invoiceable to our AWS account (account id 1234-5678-9012)
- Clarify billing routing (invoice to our corporate finance vs marketplace billing) and taxes
- Target close: end of May (we prefer May 31)

I attached the MAP template we use (Meridian_MAP_v1.xlsx) — please fill in any Redwood owners and propose a final timeline. Our procurement lead is Ravi Menon (ravi.menon@meridianlabs.com).

Thanks — happy to set a short call to align.

Emma Sorensen
CTO, Meridian Labs
emma@meridianlabs.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachment: Meridian_MAP_v1.xlsx (xlsx)
From: markus_klein@redwood.com <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Emma Sorensen <emma@meridianlabs.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 15 Apr 2029 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: MAP + timeline for AWS private offer (Meridian evaluation)

Emma — thanks for the clear ask and the template. Looping in Laura (CS ops) and Jordan (Marketplace/finance) to capture the billing path and pricing appendix; Karthik will own the private offer setup with the cloud team.

Quick proposal (we'll formalize in the MAP doc):
- Week 1 (Apr 15–Apr 26): Pilot eval on GCP (sample dataset + perf check). Redwood provides a test environment and guidance.
- Week 2 (Apr 29–May 10): Security questionnaire + evidence (SOC2 report, data flow diagram).
- May 6–May 17: Procurement / legal review; draft SOW and pricing appendix.
- May 20: Target PO submission (Meridian).
- May 21–May 28: AWS Private Offer finalization & invoicing route agreed; invoice to be generated against AWS private offer and bill to Meridian Finance (billing@meridianlabs.com).
- May 31: Go-live / contract start date.

Can we shift the target close to May 28 if the PO lands by May 20? That gives us a few business days for marketplace processing. I've attached a quick SOW draft for your review (SOW-draft.pdf) and created a shared Drive folder with a preliminary MAP: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cMeridianMAP

Next actions:
- Emma/Ravi: confirm procurement contact + invoice routing email
- Meridian: confirm pilot dataset and a 2-week evaulation window
- Redwood: we will fill in the MAP owners and return a MAP_FINAL by Apr 22

Thanks — happy to jump on a 30-min call this week.

-Markus Klein
Head of Field Engineering, Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.com

Attachment: SOW-draft.pdf (pdf)
From: Emma Sorensen <emma@meridianlabs.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.com
Cc: Ravi Menon <ravi.menon@meridianlabs.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@meridianlabs.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Apr 2029 11:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: MAP + timeline for AWS private offer (Meridian evaluation)

Markus —

Thanks, that looks good. Confirming Ravi Menon (ravi.menon@meridianlabs.com) is our procurement lead and billing should be routed to billing@meridianlabs.com. Meridian's AWS account is in us-east-1.

Two quick notes:
1) Can Redwood issue the invoice to our billing contact but also copy our finance AP team? If the private offer invoice goes only to the AWS account, our AP team still needs a copy.
2) Can you provide a pilot credit or token allowance to reduce our evaluation costs? If not, we can still proceed — just wanted to request it.

If you can share MAP_FINAL by Apr 22 we’ll review and set the PO timeline.

—Emma

On Mon, Apr 15, 2029 at 10:05 AM markus_klein@redwood.com wrote:
> Emma — thanks for the clear ask and the template.... (trimmed)
From: laura_bennett@redwood.com <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 18 Apr 2029 09:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: Meridian MAP owners, billing path & deliverables

Team —

Summary of internal owners / asks so we can produce the MAP_FINAL:
- Markus: overall owner & customer liaison (external comms)
- Jordan: marketplace & billing routing (confirm whether invoice flows via AWS private offer or Redwood invoice + marketplace reconciliation)
- Karthik: private offer creation and cloud coordination (GCP pilot vs AWS private offer differences)
- Laura: compile MAP doc, SOW finalization, and handoff to Legal for redlines
- Grace: customer success and rollout plan after go-live

Jordan — can you confirm the operational steps for an AWS Private Offer invoice to be visible to Meridian AP? If not natively, list the alternative (Redwood invoice + billing reconciliation). Also prepare a pricing appendix draft (attach to MAP).

Action items (internal):
- Jordan: pricing appendix + billing-runbook draft by Apr 20
- Karthik: start private offer template + signal any cloud quota or account needs by Apr 19
- Laura: assemble MAP_FINAL using Meridian template and Redwood owners; circulate Apr 22

I’ve attached the DocuSign SOW link for Legal once we have agreement: https://app.docusign.com/some-sow-link

Thanks — I’ll chase Legal once the draft hits my inbox.

Laura Bennett
Director, Customer Success Ops, Redwood Inference

From: markus_klein@redwood.com <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Emma Sorensen <emma@meridianlabs.com>, Ravi Menon <ravi.menon@meridianlabs.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 22 Apr 2029 15:02:00 -07:00
Subject: MAP_FINAL and next steps — Meridian Labs (target close May 28)

Emma / Ravi —

Attached is the finalized MAP (MAP_FINAL.xlsx) and the condensed plan below. We adjusted a few milestone dates to align with your procurement windows and Jordan confirmed the billing path. Please review and confirm acceptance so we can proceed to PO.

Condensed MAP_FINAL (owners + dates):
- Apr 15–Apr 26: Pilot eval (GCP) — Owner: Markus / Karthik — Acceptance: sample perf + correctness checklist
- Apr 29–May 10: Security intake & evidence exchange — Owner: Markus / Laura — Deliverables: SOC2 summary, DFD, encryption notes
- May 6–May 17: Legal & procurement review; SOW negotiations — Owner: Laura — Deliverable: signed SOW or redlines
- May 20: Target PO submission (Meridian) — Owner: Ravi (Meridian)
- May 21–May 24: AWS Private Offer processing — Owner: Jordan (Redwood) — Deliverable: Private Offer accepted + invoice generated
- May 25–May 28: Final validation & go-live prep — Owner: Grace — Deliverable: service enabled and billing confirmed
- May 28: Target go-live / contract effective date if PO provided by May 20

Billing path (confirmed by Jordan):
- Private Offer method: Redwood will create the AWS Private Offer and invoice through AWS Marketplace which will generate an invoice accessible to Meridian AP. Redwood will also send a copy of the invoice to billing@meridianlabs.com and ap@meridianlabs.com for reconciliation. If any taxes or regional billing metadata are required, Ravi please provide Meridian tax ID and billing address.

Pilot credit request: we can apply a one-time evaluation credit of $5,000 offset against the first invoice. We will reflect that in the pricing appendix.

Next steps / asks for Meridian:
1) Confirm PO timing and billing contact (ap@meridianlabs.com)
2) Provide tax ID and billing address for invoice metadata
3) Confirm pilot dataset delivery date (we recommend Apr 19)

When you confirm, we’ll route the SOW to DocuSign and start the private offer flow.

Thanks and excited to move forward.

-Markus Klein
Head of Field Engineering, Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.com

Attachments: MAP_FINAL.xlsx (xlsx); pricing appendix (embedded in MAP_FINAL)
